features.title: Speak with your campaign companion
features.description: Offline Windows dictation, optional OpenAI online dictation and live conversation with reviewed campaign and linked-terrain changes. Voice uses your OpenAI API account.

features.title: Reusable campaign workspaces
features.description: Open a campaign.tfcampaign workspace, link shared terrain files, review source updates and export a portable campaign.

features.title: Readable local campaign memory
features.description: Markdown memory, retained conversations and previous summaries stay on your PC. AI summaries remain drafts until approved.
